# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User is in Visual Studio, has cloned a Git repo, needs help navigating or analyzing code
- Ensure that types used in a using statement implement 'System.IDisposable' to avoid errors like CS1674: 'ReportGenerationForm': type used in a using statement must implement 'System.IDisposable'
- ReportGenerationForm must implement IDisposable to be used in using statement
